title: RAG Engine — Private Pattern 2
description: Template schema for deploying private, enterprise-grade RAG infrastructure with flexible vector databases (Managed KNN/ANN, Vector Search, Pinecone, Weaviate), VPC networking (create new or attach existing), restricted IAM invokers, and optional private Cloud Run serving layer.

description.default: Vertex AI RAG Engine — Private Pattern 2 (pattern_2_RAGEngine)

allowed_invoker_members.description: List of IAM identities granted access to invoke the private RAG service.

use_existing_network.description: If true, attach to existing VPC and connector. If false, create a new VPC.

network_name.description: Name of new VPC network (when use_existing_network = false).

enable_nat_gateway.description: Whether to provision Cloud NAT for private outbound traffic.

existing_connector_id.description: Existing VPC Access connector ID (when use_existing_network = true).

create_staging_bucket.description: Whether to create a GCS staging bucket for document ingestion.

staging_bucket_name.description: Custom name for document staging bucket.

ann_leaf_count.description: Leaf count when vector_db_type is rag_managed_ann.

ann_tree_depth.description: Tree depth when vector_db_type is rag_managed_ann.

vs_dimensions.description: Dimensions for Vertex Vector Search index.

pinecone_api_key.description: API key for Pinecone (stored in Secret Manager).

weaviate_api_key.description: API key for Weaviate (stored in Secret Manager).

enable_cloud_run.description: Whether to deploy the optional private Cloud Run FastAPI serving layer.

container_image.description: Container image URI for Cloud Run.

min_instances.description: Minimum instances for Cloud Run (kept warm for private SLA).

max_instances.description: Maximum instances for Cloud Run autoscaling.
